triage.pre_fix_wrong_because: Chapter 87's §122 surcharge was zeroed on the witness's exemplar-line flags entry_is_line_a/entry_is_line_b rather than on the 9903.03.03 exclusion list and the §232-covered aluminum/steel/copper carve-out its own proof atoms cite, suppressing the surcharge on §301-member lines of every origin, and the other authority components were likewise gated on exemplar identity rather than list membership.

Same caveats as index 84 apply: double-nested steel proof atoms citing unresolvable 9903.81.87/.88 at this commit, repaired later in the PR; residual entry_is_line_a/b/d usage retained.
triage.verifier_justification: The pre-fix `section_122_component_rate` zeroed the 10% surcharge whenever `entry_is_line_a or entry_is_line_b`, but that rule's own exception proof atoms ground the exemption on the 9903.03.03 subdivision (aa)(ii) exclusion list, on 7202.11.10, and on "articles of aluminum, of steel, or of copper or derivative aluminum or steel articles provided for in headings 9903.82.02 and 9903.82.04" — none of which is exemplar-line identity, and the pinned corpus confirms 9903.03.03 is a list-membership heading ("Articles the product of any country, as provided for in subdivision (aa)(ii) of U.S. note 2 to this subchapter"). The same module simultaneously uses `entry_is_line_a`/`entry_is_line_b` as the China §301 list-1/2/3 and 2024-action gates in `china_section_301_component_rate`, so no binding of those inputs can satisfy both provisions: the §122 branch had no source basis and the fix re-grounds it on `entry_is_section_122_exempt or entry_is_section_232_covered`, with the PR reporting the evaluated wrong output. This is a condition with no basis in the cited source that the fix removes and re-grounds, so untraceable_branch fits; the change is not mechanical (formula tokens, not just excerpts or hashes, changed) and not mere new coverage for the anchored rule.
triage.verifier_notes: Bundled change, so a reviewer should know what else is inside it. (1) The §122, §232-aluminum, §201, and China-301 hunks are all the same defect shape: exemplar-identity gates replaced by membership-semantic gates (line_a→section_122_exempt/china_301_list123, line_b→section_232_covered/section_232_aluminum/china_301_2024_action, line_c→china_301_list4a, line_e→section_201_cspv/china_301_solar). (2) The Brazil and forced-labor hunks additionally ADD a missing list-membership conjunct (`if entry_is_brazil_301_listed and origin_is_brazil:`, `elif entry_is_forced_labor_301_listed and (origin_is_eu or origin_is_taiwan):`), which read alone is unrepresented_clause — that is the runner-up kind, and wrong_entity_or_scope is a defensible third framing since the wrong population of lines got the exemption. I kept untraceable_branch because the anchored rule_path (section_122_component_rate versions[1].formula) is a removal/re-grounding, and because those Brazil/forced-labor versions start 2026-07-22 and 2026-07-24, outside the evaluated April-June window, while the §122 version (2026-02-24 to 2026-07-23) is inside it. (3) `section_232_steel_component_rate`, `ch87_s232_steel_heading_rate`, and the `+ section_232_steel_component_rate` stack line are NEW coverage the witness never had ("The witness's steel exemplar (a ferroalloy) sits outside note 16(c), which is why no witness slot existed") — by the task's own rule that part is not a defect, so do not let it inflate the finding. (4) Partial fix: `entry_is_reciprocal_annex_excluded: formula: entry_is_line_a` and `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded: formula: entry_is_line_b` are untouched by this commit, and `entry_is_line_d` still gates beer/§338 by the post-fix summary's own admission ("Beer/section-338 keeps entry_is_line_d because no membership module exists"), so the exemplar coupling survives elsewhere in the module. (5) Provenance caveat: the §122 atoms cite chapter-99 page-221/page-226/page-230 at a Rev. 15 vintage, but the pinned release resolves those paths to Rev. 3 pages whose text is about 9903.01.77 and §232 steel quotas, not the quoted excerpts — page drift, not evidence about this classification, but worth a separate look.
